cohort: Women aged 45 years and older using donated oocytes for IVF in Taiwan between 2007 and 2016, specifically 1226 embryo transfer cycles from 745 women.
finding: Live birth rates and secondary/perinatal outcomes, including cumulative live birth rate, did not significantly differ across maternal age groups (45-46 vs. >=50 years) in women using donor oocytes for IVF, though a non-significant trend towards decreased live birth rate and birthweight with increasing maternal age was observed.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates did not significantly differ across maternal age groups in women using donor oocytes for IVF.
